definitions.explanation: Education that is legally required. In Japan, compulsory education covers nine years: six years of elementary school (小学校) and three years of junior high school (中学校), for children aged 6 to 15.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{義務教育|ぎむきょういく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{九|きゅう}→九：00728_kyuu⟧⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧だ。
examples.english: Compulsory education in Japan lasts nine years.

examples.japanese: {義務教育|ぎむきょういく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{授業料|じゅぎょうりょう}→授業料：14967_jugyouryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧だ。
examples.english: Tuition is free during the compulsory education period.

examples.japanese: {義務教育|ぎむきょういく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{学習|がくしゅう}{指導|しどう}{要領|ようりょう}→学習指導要領：26215_gakushuushidouyouryou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{定|さだ}められている→定める：10448_sadameru⟧。
examples.english: The content taught in compulsory education is determined by the national curriculum guidelines.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧ (duty, obligation) and ⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧ (education). In Japan, {義務教育|ぎむきょういく} covers ⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧ (elementary, 6 years) and ⟦{中学校|ちゅうがっこう}→中学校：01465_chuugakkou⟧ (junior high, 3 years). High school (⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧) is not part of compulsory education, though over 98% of students attend.

The obligation is on the parent/guardian to ensure the child receives education, not on the child to attend. Public school {義務教育|ぎむきょういく} is tuition-free.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {義務教育|ぎむきょういく}{課程|かてい}: compulsory education curriculum
- {義務教育|ぎむきょういく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive compulsory education
- {義務教育|ぎむきょういく}{学校|がっこう}: compulsory education school
